;Science and technology
*[[Atira asteroid]]
**The [[Zwicky Transient Facility]] in California discovers a large [[Atira asteroid]], {{mpl|2019 AQ|3}}, an asteroid with a diameter of {{convert|1.4|km|mi|abbr=off}} that stays closer to the Sun during its orbit than any other known asteroid, passing from inside the orbit of Mercury to just outside the orbit of Venus. [https://www.minorplanetcenter.net/mpec/K19/K19A88.html (Minor Planet Center)]
